anchor.hook_eyebrow: The question that keeps trade-finance teams awake
anchor.hook_lead: Here is our monitoring coverage for one threat — trade-based money laundering: value moved by mispricing goods, not by moving money. Green is covered by a live signal. Amber is partial. Red is a known typology we are not catching. TBML is roughly 2% of suspicious reports but an estimated 42% of laundered value — the gap hides in plain sight.
anchor.close_title: The blind spot closes — and stays closed
anchor.lift_rationale: This is the case for atoms over monolithic scenarios. A price-anomaly rule alone drowns in legitimate transfer-pricing noise. Composed with related-party trade and a high-risk corridor, it becomes a precise, explainable rule — and the engine discovers that combination instead of an analyst guessing it.
anchor.source: Indicators grounded in the FinCEN Alert on fentanyl-linked trade-based laundering (Apr 2025) & the FATF report on TBML trends & developments (2024)

indicators.label: Invoice price diverging from market benchmark
indicators.sub: over- / under-invoicing moves value without moving goods

indicators.label: Goods inconsistent with the counterparty's stated business
Phantom shipment — payment with no matching goods movement
Carousel / re-invoicing of the same goods
Settlement terms inconsistent with the goods
Third-party payer unrelated to the trade
Shell / front company with no operating history
Electronics / dual-use goods tied to illicit-drug supply chains

advisory_stream.t: FinCEN Alert — Trade-Based Money Laundering Linked to Illicit-Drug Supply Chains (Apr 2025).
2% of suspicious reports yet an estimated 42% of laundered value
. Networks settle drug proceeds by trading goods — often
— rather than wiring funds. Value is moved by
over- and under-invoicing against true market price
. Document-to-payment consistency is expected in the narrative.

definition.logic: unit price deviates from the HS-code market median by > 40% AND counterparty price variance > 0.3 over 90 days
definition.source: Trade-finance invoices (Gold) + public HS-code price indices
